decisions.reason: Even though it was no longer visible as a standalone website item, it is tightly rooted in the firm's core authentication and trusted second-channel security knowledge, so high absorptive capacity favors continued retention, possibly as an integrated module rather than a withdrawal.

Mobile PDF signing remains close to the firm's identity, authorization and online-contract-signing trajectory, and its strong in-house R&D gives it the knowledge base to refine the offer rather than abandon it.

Although technically related to the firm's secure communication stack, this looks like a narrower application with weaker visible traction, so the firm is likely to reallocate resources from this niche product to broader platform development.

Payment security compliance still builds on the firm's regulated-security capabilities and can benefit from its existing cryptography and infrastructure know-how, so absorptive capacity supports keeping it despite some adjacency and packaging risk.
